notes: The documents whose role-gate claims the ROLE_MATRIX contradicts: comment creation stated as open to viewers, project archiving stated as owner-only, and the flags settings screen stated as member-and-above. Projected from tasks/keys/docs-discrepancies.json, which was written when the discrepancies were planted, so the key never depends on re-reading the documents. Derived mechanically by scripts/derive-keys.ts from corpus/taskflow/docs/** using the same two conventions scripts/check-docs-corpus.ts enforces (a heading whose text starts with an id DEFINES it; a backticked src/tests/scripts path is a code citation); re-running it must reproduce this file. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root. The aggregator documents traceability.md, glossary.md and every index.md are excluded from doc keys: they are generated from, or index, the whole corpus, so they cite nearly every id and path and would appear in every answer regardless of the question.
